finding.claim: With cache enabled, tokens lacking a numeric iat are cached with a TTL of now+cacheTTL, ignoring exp, so expired tokens are accepted from cache.
finding.source: Holder of a valid token that has exp but no iat (e.g. signed with noTimestamp: true, signer.js:96).
finding.sink: Cache-hit path returns cached payload without rerunning exp validation (verifier.js:363-379).

trace.note: hasIat is false when payload.iat is not a number.
exp-based TTL computation at lines 123-129 is inside the hasIat block and never runs.
cacheValue[2] stays 0, so TTL falls back to clockTimestamp + clockTolerance + cacheTTL (cacheTTL default 600000 at verifier.js:499).
Subsequent verify call hits the cache; exp validator at lines 304-323 is not run.

finding.guards_checked: Cache is opt-in (verifier.js:84-85, disabled unless cache option set). exp validator at verifier.js:304-323 runs only on cache miss. TTL logic at 117-134 is correct only when iat is present.

finding.sink: hashToken(token) at utils.js:46 invoked from verifier.js:364 before decode.
